title: hotfix: slo-enforcer & circuit-breaker backoff tuning to prevent regional thrash
author: Aisha Patel
description: Background: After an incident on 2026-02-27 where aggressive SLO enforcement combined with a short circuit-breaker backoff led to repeat regional failovers and increased latency for bursty traffic, this hotfix adjusts enforcer thresholds and adds exponential backoff to the regional circuit breaker. Motivation: prevent thrashing during transient capacity degradation and provide a smoother degradation curve (graceful degradation) so customer requests either get routed to fallback variants or experience limited shedding rather than repeated failovers. The PR includes: - tighten SLO violation window calculations to avoid reacting to short spikes - increase the default backoff multiplier and add jitter to regional CBs - add a grace-period for autoscaler-triggered capacity changes so enforcer doesn't immediately shed - add unit + integration tests exercising backoff and failover paths - update helm values for dedicated and private installs - release notes and mitigation steps for on-call. Checklist: - [x] unit tests updated - [x] integration test added (canary) - [x] metrics added for backoff duration and cb state transitions - [x] docs/release-notes updated - [x] CI green and manual canary in staging

Ops: bump default helm values for cb_backoff_min_ms and cb_backoff_multiplier

notes_for_oncall: If regional failover rate remains elevated after the hotfix, temporarily raise cb_backoff_multiplier in helm values for the affected region and contact infra on-call to inspect autoscaler churn. Revert to previous after stability is observed.
motivation_context: This PR is a targeted hotfix following the Feb 27 incident; goal is not to redesign enforcer but to stop immediate thrashing while long-term changes (ENG-9482) iterate.
risk_assessment: Low-medium: changes are limited to SLO enforcer logic and circuit-breaker backoff. Config flags allow quick rollback. Added tests and canary validated behaviour in staging.
test_plan: Unit tests covering exponential backoff and SLO windowing, integration canary that simulates transient capacity drops, manual validation of metric emission, and a short production canary rollout with traffic mirroring for 2 hours.
